g.text: Terms: CG = centre of gravity · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · KB = kilobyte, a file size of 1,024 bytes · SUS-CAD-001 = the concept layouts document
